description: Linea — Colore: Dark grey & gold on ivory Collezione: Armonia Codice: 5955 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Stripe Scala: Small Altezza: 55.12 cm Toni: White A complete reinvention of Fortuny’s MALMAISON stripe pattern, the varying line widths evoke rhythm and movement, creating a three-dimensional effect. LINEA turns the stripe into a study of its own form. By varying the widths of each line across the repeat, an optical sensation of a three-dimensional relief on a flat surface is created . This is the logic of Op Art applied to interior textile: precise, restrained, and quietly hypnotic at scale. Its small repeat makes it technically one of the most versatile textiles in the ARMONIA collection — performing equally on tightly upholstered seating, on walls where the eye naturally travels vertically, and on drapery where the varying stripe widths create subtle movement in motion. Ideal for interiors that value proportion and architectural clarity. Part of the ARMONIA collection , designed in collaboration with Chahan Minassian.
